name: Okami Misao "Oba-san, Kon'ya mo Mesu ni Naru no ne..."
original_name: 女将・美紗緒「叔母さん、今夜も牝になるのね…」
source:
Main character returns to his hometown on his father's anniversary and stays at aunt's ryokan. He is fascinated by the beauty of his cousin. One night he sees the girl masturbating, and calling her out impulsively leads to a complex relationship with his cousin and aunt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父亲忌日，我回到故乡，在姨母美纱绪经营的日式旅馆留宿。表妹和纱的美貌令我着迷。一天夜里，我撞见她自慰；冲动地叫住她后，我与表妹和姨母的关系变得复杂起来。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
